description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to the Bootstrap grid system, including container, row, column, and offset styles and breakpoints.

methods.name: make-container
methods.description: Creates a flexible container with configurable gutters and centered margins.

methods.name: make-container-max-widths
methods.description: Defines maximum container widths at various breakpoints via media queries.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Generates a flex container for grid rows with wrapping and negative margins for gutters.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares columns with relative positioning and full width, adding horizontal padding.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines a flexible column with a specified size relative to total columns.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Offsets a column by a specified number of columns.
